comments.rawMarkdown: Not looking to join a solver team, but flagging a Paper Track team-up for anyone here with a strong ARC-AGI-3 score. I have a finished, submitted methods paper (noise metrology of the score + a pre-registered disclosure experiment) but only a 0.79 leaderboard score. Leaderboard prizes stop at the top 5, so a strong score outside that band wins nothing there — but it's exactly the "Accuracy" input the Paper Track rewards. Your score + my finished paper = one joint submission strong on both axes. Even prize split by default, negotiable. Full details: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/arc-prize-2026-arc-agi-3/discussion/732932 — merger deadline Oct 26.
